termos.metaDescription: Terms of Use of the BipFix platform for drivers, repair shops and parts stores in the European Union.

secoes.titulo: 1. Who we are and when these Terms apply
paragrafos: BipFix ("we", "us") operates the bipfix.com website and the BipFix mobile app (together, the "Platform"). BipFix is currently being registered as a private limited company (osaühing) in Estonia. Until the registration is completed, the Platform is operated by its founder as a natural person. Once the company is registered, this section will state its legal name, registry code and registered address. You can contact us at support@bipfix.com.

These Terms apply to the English, Estonian, Italian, European Portuguese and Russian versions of the Platform and to everyone who uses it from the European Economic Area. The Brazilian Portuguese version of the Platform is intended for users in Brazil and is governed by separate terms based on Brazilian law. By creating an account or using the Platform you accept these Terms. How we process personal data is explained in our Privacy Policy.

BipFix is an online intermediation platform. It connects drivers and vehicle owners who need a repair ("Customers") with auto repair shops ("Repair Shops") and auto parts stores ("Stores"), together "Partners". Through the Platform, Customers describe their problem and receive quotes, and Partners can send quotes, communicate with Customers, track the work and buy or sell parts from each other.

BipFix does not carry out repairs or sell parts and is not a party to the contract between a Customer and a Partner. When you accept a quote, the contract for the repair or the part is concluded directly between you and the Partner, who is responsible for the work, the price, the deadlines and the guarantee.

All Partners register on BipFix as businesses and declare that they act as traders. This means that, as a consumer, the EU consumer protection rules apply to your contract with the Partner (see section 11).

itens: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account.
The information you provide (name, contact details and, for Partners, business name, registry or VAT code and address) must be true, complete and kept up to date.
You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for activity on your account. Tell us immediately at support@bipfix.com if you suspect unauthorised use.

Whoever registers a Repair Shop or Store declares that they are the person responsible for that business (owner, director or someone authorised to represent it) and that they are aware that using the Platform, which is free today, may involve costs in the future under section 5.

Partners confirm that they hold the registrations, licences and permits required for their activity. We may ask for supporting documents and may refuse a registration that contains false, incomplete or unverifiable information.

paragrafos: Using the Platform is free for Customers: requesting quotes, comparing them, tracking the repair and leaving reviews cost nothing. You pay only the Partner, for the repair or part you agree with them.

Using BipFix is currently free for Partners as well: there is no subscription, no commission and no per-job fee. In the future we may start charging Partners, for example a percentage of the jobs arranged through the Platform, a fixed fee per job, a subscription, or a combination of these; the conditions may be set for all Partners or specifically for each Partner.

Before any fee is charged, we will inform the affected Partners by email and on the Platform at least 30 calendar days in advance, describing the pricing model, the amount or percentage, any criteria that make the fee vary (for example, the volume of work) and the date from which it applies. A Partner who does not accept the new conditions may close its account before that date without any penalty.

secoes.titulo: 6. How requests are distributed and how results are shown
paragrafos: The main parameters that determine what Partners and Customers see are the following:
itens: Distribution of requests to Partners: a Customer's request is shown to the Repair Shops whose service area (the radius set by each Repair Shop, 30 km by default) covers the address of the request and that offer the type of service requested. Emergency requests (for example after an accident) are sent to Repair Shops that do collision or body work, giving priority to those that still have free capacity for that type of work according to the capacity they have declared.

Quotes shown to Customers: each quote is shown with its price, deadline and the Repair Shop's rating, so that the Customer can compare them. No Partner can pay to have its quote shown in a better position.

Public list of Repair Shops: the public list of partner Repair Shops is ordered by average rating, then by number of reviews, then by how long the Repair Shop has been on the Platform. No Partner can pay to appear higher in the list.
depois: If we change these parameters, we will update this section and inform Partners in advance in accordance with section 17.

paragrafos: As a Partner you agree to:
itens: provide truthful information about your prices, deadlines, availability and services;
honour the quotes and deadlines you give to Customers through the Platform, unless the Customer agrees to a change;
not encourage Customers to conclude the deal or pay outside the Platform in order to avoid a fee that is in force and has been announced under section 5;
not manipulate, buy or exchange reviews or ratings;
treat Customers and other Partners with respect, without discrimination, harassment, pressure or unfair or misleading commercial practices;
comply with the laws that apply to your business, including consumer protection, tax, labour and environmental law, and use the personal data of Customers only to provide the service they requested.

secoes.titulo: 8. Restriction, suspension and termination of Partner accounts
itens: Minor or isolated issues (for example slow responses or outdated information) will normally lead to a warning and a reasonable period to fix the problem.

Restriction or suspension: if we restrict or suspend a Partner's account, we will send the Partner a statement of reasons, with the specific facts and the grounds under these Terms, before or at the latest when the measure takes effect.

Termination: if we decide to terminate a Partner's use of the Platform entirely, we will give at least 30 days' notice with a statement of reasons. We may terminate or suspend immediately, still with a statement of reasons, only where the law requires it or in case of serious or repeated breaches, such as: fraud or attempts to evade a fee in force; false information about parts, services or prices; charging amounts different from the accepted quote without justification; harassment or discrimination of Customers; misuse of Customers' personal data; a pattern of serious Customer complaints; or illegal activity established by a competent authority.
The Partner may clarify the facts and ask us to reconsider by writing to support@bipfix.com. If the reason for the measure no longer applies, we will restore the account without undue delay.

Only Customers who had a service completed by a Repair Shop through BipFix can review it: the Platform technically allows a review only for the Repair Shop whose quote the Customer accepted, and only after the request has been marked as completed. Each completed service can be reviewed once.
The author can edit their review for up to 2 months after publishing it. Reviews are shown with the name displayed in the author's account and the date.

We do not pay for reviews, and we do not hide or reorder reviews depending on whether they are positive or negative. We remove a review only if it is illegal, demonstrably false, offensive or unrelated to the service, and in that case we inform the author of the reason.
The public rating of a Repair Shop is the average of all its published reviews.

secoes.titulo: 10. Your content and reporting illegal content
paragrafos: You are responsible for the content you publish on the Platform (descriptions, photos, messages, reviews, profile information). It must not be illegal, misleading or infringe the rights of others. You keep the rights to your content, and you give BipFix a free licence to store and display it on the Platform to the extent needed to provide the service.

Anyone can report content they consider illegal by writing to support@bipfix.com with: an explanation of why the content is illegal, the exact location of the content (for example the page address), the reporter's name and email address (except for certain reports about child sexual abuse material), and a statement that the report is made in good faith and is accurate and complete. We will confirm receipt, handle the report in a timely, diligent and objective manner and inform the reporter of our decision.

If we remove content, restrict its visibility or restrict an account, we will send the user concerned a statement of reasons and explain how to contest the decision. Our single point of contact for users and for the authorities of the EU Member States is support@bipfix.com; you can write to us in English or Estonian.

Nothing in these Terms limits the rights you have as a consumer under the mandatory law of your country of residence. In particular, your statutory rights regarding the repair or the part (for example the right to have a defective repair corrected or to claim remedies for a defective part) exist against the Partner who carried out the work or sold the part.

If you have a problem with a Partner, you can write to us at support@bipfix.com and we will try to help find a solution, free of charge. This does not affect your right to contact your national consumer protection authority or to go to court. In Estonia, consumers can refer disputes free of charge to the Consumer Disputes Committee of the Consumer Protection and Technical Regulatory Authority (Tarbijakaitse ja Tehnilise Järelevalve Amet, www.ttja.ee).

Partners can send complaints about the Platform, about technical problems or about any measure we have taken against their account to support@bipfix.com. Complaints are free of charge; we will consider them with due care and reply within a reasonable time. BipFix is currently a small enterprise within the meaning of Commission Recommendation 2003/361/EC, so the obligation to name external mediators under Regulation (EU) 2019/1150 does not yet apply to us.

The BipFix name and logo, the design of the Platform and its source code belong to BipFix or its licensors. You may not copy, reverse-engineer or use them without our permission, except as allowed by law.
We take care in verifying Partner registrations and in running the Platform, but the Partner, not BipFix, is responsible for the quality and result of the repair and for the part sold.
We do not guarantee that the Platform will always be available without interruption; there may be pauses for maintenance, failures of third-party services or events beyond our control.

Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits our liability for damage caused intentionally or through gross negligence, for death or personal injury, or in any other case where liability cannot be limited by law.

You can stop using the Platform and ask us to close your account at any time by writing to support@bipfix.com. Closing your account does not affect contracts already concluded with a Partner. What happens to your data after closing is explained in the Privacy Policy.

You may not use the Platform for illegal purposes, try to access other users' data or accounts, interfere with the operation of the Platform, or collect data from it in an automated way without our permission.

We may change these Terms, for example when the company registration is completed, when we introduce new features or when the law changes. We will inform registered users of significant changes by email or on the Platform before they take effect: at least 30 days in advance for changes that affect Partners (or longer if needed to adapt), and within a reasonable period for Customers. If you do not agree with the changes, you can close your account before they take effect.

These Terms are governed by Estonian law. If you are a consumer, this choice of law does not deprive you of the protection of the mandatory rules of the country where you live, and you can bring proceedings in the courts of that country.
For disputes between BipFix and Partners, Harju County Court (Harju Maakohus) in Tallinn has jurisdiction, unless mandatory law provides otherwise.
Questions about these Terms: support@bipfix.com. Questions about personal data: privacy@bipfix.com.

privacidade.metaDescription: How BipFix processes the personal data of drivers, repair shops and parts stores in the European Union, in accordance with the GDPR.

secoes.titulo: 1. Who is responsible for your data
paragrafos: The controller of your personal data under the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 ("GDPR") is BipFix ("we", "us").

BipFix is currently being registered as a private limited company (osaühing) in Estonia. Until the registration is completed, BipFix is operated by its founder as a natural person, who is the controller. Once the company is registered, this section will state its legal name, registry code and registered address.

For any question or request about your personal data, write to privacy@bipfix.com. We have not appointed a Data Protection Officer because we are not required to; requests sent to this address are handled directly by the people responsible for data protection at BipFix.

This policy applies to the English, Estonian, Italian, European Portuguese and Russian versions of bipfix.com, to the BipFix mobile app and to everyone who uses them from the European Economic Area: drivers ("Customers"), repair shops and parts stores ("Partners") and their staff, and visitors of the website. It also applies to repair shops and parts stores that we contact about a partnership (section 3.8).
The Portuguese version of the website is intended for users in Brazil and is governed by a separate policy based on Brazilian law (LGPD).

secoes.titulo: 3. What data we process, why, and on what legal basis
paragrafos: For each purpose we indicate the legal basis under Article 6(1) GDPR.

itens: Data: name, email address, phone number, password (stored only in encrypted/hashed form), preferred language and account type. For Partners also: business name, registry or VAT code, address, services offered, opening hours, logo and photos, and the name, email and role of staff members they add.
Purpose: creating and managing your account and letting you use the platform.
Legal basis: performance of a contract with you (Art. 6(1)(b)).

secoes.titulo: 3.2 Repair requests, quotes, messages and reviews
itens: Data: vehicle details (make, model, year and, if you provide it, the licence plate), description of the problem, photos, voice messages, urgency, the address where the service is needed, quotes, chat messages, orders, service history and reviews.

Purpose: sending your request to suitable Partners near you, letting Partners send quotes, enabling communication between you and the Partner, tracking the repair, and showing reviews on Partner profiles.

Legal basis: performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)). Publishing reviews together with the name shown in your account is based on our legitimate interest, and that of other drivers, in transparent information about repair shops (Art. 6(1)(f)).
Data: the address you enter and its geographic coordinates or, only if you allow it on your device, your current location.
Purpose: matching you with Partners close to you and showing Partners on a map.
Legal basis: performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)). You can always type an address instead of sharing your device location.

secoes.titulo: 3.4 Damage analysis and voice transcription with artificial intelligence
itens: Data: the photos of the damage and the voice messages you choose to send through these features.

Purpose: producing an indicative description of the damage and a text transcription of voice messages, to help Partners prepare a quote. The result is only an aid: the price and the diagnosis are always decided by the Partner, and no decision with legal or similarly significant effects is made about you automatically (Art. 22).
Legal basis: performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)). The processing is carried out by Google (Gemini) on our behalf (see section 4).

If a user reports an accident on BipFix and provides details of the other vehicle involved (such as its licence plate and the other driver's name, email or phone number), we use those details to inform the other driver about the report and about how to follow up on the repair.

Legal basis: the legitimate interest of both drivers in dealing with the consequences of the accident (Art. 6(1)(f)). If you received such a message and do not want to use BipFix, you can ask us to delete your details.
We send emails about your account and your requests, for example new quotes, accepted quotes, completed services and password recovery links.
Legal basis: performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)). We only send marketing messages to Customers who have given their consent (Art. 6(1)(a)), and you can unsubscribe at any time.

secoes.titulo: 3.7 Security, website operation and visit summaries
itens: Technical data: IP address, browser and device type, pages requested and error reports, recorded in server logs to keep the platform secure, prevent fraud and abuse, and fix errors.

Visit summaries (only if you accept cookies): if you click "Accept" in the cookie banner, the pages you visit and the time spent on each are kept temporarily in your browser tab (session storage, deleted when you close the tab) and sent to our server. The server combines them with the referring site (for example Google or Instagram), device and browser type, language and approximate city and country estimated from your IP address into a summary of the visit, which is emailed only to the BipFix team. We use it to understand how the website is used during our launch and to improve it. The summary shows the IP address only partially and it is not stored in our database. Visits by people logged in as BipFix administrators are excluded.

Legal basis: for technical data, our legitimate interest in operating a secure website (Art. 6(1)(f)); for visit summaries, your consent (Art. 6(1)(a)), which you can withdraw at any time (see section 9) without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal.

secoes.titulo: 3.8 Contacting repair shops and parts stores about a partnership
itens: Data: business name, business email, phone, website and registered address of repair shops and parts stores, taken from public sources such as the Estonian Business Register (äriregister) and the business's own website.
Purpose: contacting the business once or a few times to present the BipFix partnership.

Legal basis: our legitimate interest in offering our service to businesses (Art. 6(1)(f)). Every message explains how to stop receiving them; if you ask us to stop, we will not contact you again and will keep only what is needed to respect that request.

secoes.titulo: 3.9 Analytics and session recording (only with your consent)
itens: If you accept analytics cookies in the cookie banner, we use Google Analytics to produce aggregated statistics and Microsoft Clarity to understand how pages are used (for example clicks, scrolling and anonymised session recordings).

Legal basis: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a)), which you can withdraw at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal. Before you give consent, these tools run in a restricted mode without analytics cookies.
We keep accounting records and respond to lawful requests from public authorities where the law requires it (Art. 6(1)(c)).

paragrafos: We share personal data only as far as necessary:
itens: Other users: the Customer and the Partner involved in the same request or order see each other's details needed to carry out the service (name, contact details, vehicle details and photos, address where relevant). Partner profiles and reviews are public.
Hosting: our servers and database are located in the Netherlands (European Union).
Resend (United States): sending of emails.
Google (United States): Gemini artificial intelligence for damage analysis and voice transcription; Google Analytics (only with consent); Google Maps, shown on Partner profile pages.
Microsoft (United States): Microsoft Clarity (only with consent).
OpenStreetMap Foundation (United Kingdom): converting addresses into map coordinates (Nominatim service).
Public authorities, when we are legally required to disclose data.
depois: These service providers process data on our instructions under data processing terms that meet the requirements of Article 28 GDPR. We do not sell personal data.

secoes.titulo: 5. Transfers outside the European Economic Area
paragrafos: Some of the providers above are located in the United States or the United Kingdom. Transfers to the United Kingdom rely on the European Commission's adequacy decision. Transfers to the United States rely on the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework adequacy decision where the provider is certified under it, and otherwise on the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (Art. 46(2)(c) GDPR). You can ask us for more information about these safeguards at privacy@bipfix.com.

secoes.titulo: 6. How long we keep your data
itens: Account data: as long as your account is active. After you ask us to delete your account, we delete or anonymise your data within 30 days, except for the data listed below that we must or may keep for longer.
Requests, quotes, orders and messages: as long as your account is active and up to 3 years after the last transaction, to deal with possible disputes and warranty claims.
Accounting records: 7 years, as required by the Estonian Accounting Act.
Server logs: up to 14 days.
Visit summaries: deleted from the team mailbox after 12 months at the latest.
Analytics (only with consent): according to the retention settings of Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity, at most 14 months.
Partnership contacts (section 3.8): until you ask us to stop contacting you, and at most 24 months after our last contact.

paragrafos: Under the GDPR you have the right to:
itens: access your personal data and receive a copy of it (Art. 15);
have inaccurate or incomplete data corrected (Art. 16);
have your data erased (Art. 17);
restrict the processing of your data (Art. 18);
receive the data you provided to us in a structured, machine-readable format and have it transmitted to another controller (Art. 20);
object at any time to processing based on our legitimate interest, and to direct marketing without having to give a reason (Art. 21);
withdraw your consent at any time, where processing is based on consent (Art. 7(3)).
depois: To exercise any of these rights, write to privacy@bipfix.com. We will reply without undue delay and at the latest within one month; this period may be extended by two further months for complex requests, in which case we will tell you why. Exercising your rights is free of charge. We may ask you to confirm your identity before acting on a request.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, in particular in the EU country where you live or work. In Estonia this is the Data Protection Inspectorate (Andmekaitse Inspektsioon), Tatari 39, 10134 Tallinn, info@aki.ee, www.aki.ee. We would appreciate the chance to address your concern first.

paragrafos: The data marked as required when you register or send a request is needed to provide the service; without it we cannot create your account or process your request. Other data, such as your device location, analytics cookies or voice messages, is optional.

We use technologies that store information in your browser that are strictly necessary for the website to work: keeping you logged in, remembering your language and remembering your cookie choice. These do not require consent. Analytics cookies (Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity) and the visit summaries described in section 3.7 are only used if you click "Accept" in the cookie banner; if you reject or ignore the banner, they are not used.
To change your cookie choice, delete the data stored by bipfix.com in your browser settings; the cookie banner will appear again on your next visit.

We protect personal data with appropriate technical and organisational measures, including encrypted connections (HTTPS), hashed passwords, authentication-based access control, database-level isolation between accounts (row-level security), limited administrative access and hosting within the European Union.
BipFix is not intended for people under 18 years of age, and we do not knowingly collect their personal data.

We may update this policy, for example when the company registration is completed or when we start using a new service provider. We will inform registered users of significant changes by email or with a notice on the platform before they take effect.
Questions and requests about your personal data: privacy@bipfix.com.

docsCliente.pageSubtitle: Everything you need to know to request quotes from several repair shops, pick the best one, follow the repair and sort out any surprise, from sign-up to the end of the warranty.

secoes.intro: The account is free and takes a few minutes. You only need it to request quotes and follow your repairs.

passos.title: Start with sign-up
passos.desc: Tap "I need a repair" on the home page or "Sign up" at the top of the site and choose the driver account.

passos.title: Fill in your details
passos.desc: Name, e-mail, phone number and a password.

passos.title: Confirm your e-mail
passos.desc: Open the link we send to your e-mail. If it does not arrive within a few minutes, check your spam folder or use "Send the confirmation link again".

passos.title: Add your car
passos.desc: Under Vehicles, enter make, model, year and registration plate. You can add several cars and see the service history of each one.

secoes.intro: The request describes your car's problem and goes to nearby repair shops that do that kind of work. Requesting quotes costs you nothing.

passos.title: Choose the car
passos.desc: Select one of your saved cars or add a new one on the spot.

passos.title: Type of service
passos.desc: Mechanics, bodywork, paint, electrics, servicing, tyres and more. The type decides which workshops receive the request.

passos.title: Photos and description
passos.desc: Take photos of the damage or the warning light and describe what happens: noises, when it started, whether the car still drives. The more detail, the more accurate the quote.

passos.title: Location
passos.desc: Use GPS or type the address where the car is. The request goes to the shops whose service radius covers that spot.

passos.title: Review and send
passos.desc: Check everything and send. The shops are notified immediately and start preparing their quotes.

secoes.texto: Until you accept a quote, you can edit the request (photos, description) or cancel it. If a review of a previous service is still pending, you are asked for it before the new request.

secoes.intro: Each quote arrives separately, from a different shop, and shows: total price, items (parts and labour), lead time, warranty, validity, the time slots when the shop can take the car and the rating given by other drivers.

selos.name: Quality
selos.desc: Shop with an average rating of 4 stars or more from drivers' reviews.

selos.name: Works with your insurer
selos.desc: Shown when the repair goes through insurance and the shop works with your insurer.

selos.name: Price adjustment
selos.desc: Transparency: if the shop has already revised an accepted quote, you see how much the price changed compared with the original (for example, "12% higher").

secoes.texto: Have questions? Tap "Message the repair shop": each shop has its own conversation with you, and the others cannot see it. Quotes you are not interested in can be declined.

secoes.intro: When you accept a quote, you pick the drop-off time on the same screen from the slots the shop offered (today or in the next few days).

passos.title: Choose the slot
passos.desc: Tap the day and the period you want. Slots that have already passed are not shown.

passos.title: Accept
passos.desc: The shop is notified immediately. The other quotes for that request are closed.

passos.title: Drop off the car
passos.desc: The shop's address and the time stay on the request page. If you need to change it, use "Reschedule appointment".

secoes.texto: If you do not show up, the shop can record the no-show: the slot is released and the request goes back to you to pick again.

secoes.intro: When the car arrives, the shop checks it in and you start seeing each step on the request page, with a notification on the site:

itens.label: Received and diagnosis
itens.desc: The car is in the shop and being assessed.

itens.label: Awaiting parts / In progress
itens.desc: Shows whether the repair is on hold waiting for parts or under way. Pauses are shown too.

itens.label: Final testing
itens.desc: The work is done and being checked.

itens.label: Ready for collection
itens.desc: You get a notification to pick up the car.

itens.label: Delivered
itens.desc: The shop marks it when you collect the car. If it does not, the car counts as delivered after 5 days.

secoes.texto: Notifications are in the bell (at the top of the screen) and on the notifications page.

secoes.titulo: 6. If the shop asks to change the price
secoes.intro: Sometimes, once the car is opened up, the shop finds something that could not be seen before. Even so, it cannot simply charge more: it has to send a quote revision, with the reason, the new items and the new price. Nothing changes without your decision.

itens.label: Approve
itens.desc: The new price applies. The original price stays on record and is shown next to the quote.

itens.label: Decline and collect my car
itens.desc: The service is closed and you arrange the pick-up in the conversation. You may be charged for work already done, as agreed with the shop.

secoes.nota: BipFix keeps track of each shop's price revisions. Shops that ask for increases often or that ask for very large ones are reviewed by our team.

secoes.intro: After delivery, review the shop. Your review helps other drivers and is requested before your next request; the "I've just crashed" button is never blocked.

passos.title: Rating from 1 to 5 stars
passos.desc: For the overall quality of the service.

passos.title: Comment
passos.desc: Say how it went: timing, price, service, result.

passos.title: Publication
passos.desc: The review appears on the shop's public profile and counts towards its average rating. You can edit it later.

secoes.intro: The warranty stated in the quote starts counting when the car is delivered.

itens.label: Countdown on the home screen
itens.desc: You see how many warranty days are left for each job. Tap the countdown to open the request with its full history and message the workshop.

itens.label: Open conversation
itens.desc: The conversation with the chosen shop stays open until the warranty ends. Conversations with the other shops are closed when the service is over.

itens.label: History
itens.desc: Under History you find every service, with quote, steps and review.

secoes.intro: For when you have just crashed your car. It works even without an account and shows what to do according to the country where the accident happened, in your language.

passos.title: Tap the red button
passos.desc: It is on the home page and on your dashboard.

passos.title: Photos and location
passos.desc: Photograph the damage right away. GPS finds the address and the nearby shops that do bodywork.

passos.title: Who pays for the repair
passos.desc: The other driver's insurance, your own comprehensive (kasko) insurance or you. You can fill this in later. If your insurance is from another country, we show you how the Green Card works.

passos.title: Quotes
passos.desc: Nearby shops receive the request with priority. The car details can be completed later on the request page.

secoes.aviso: If anyone is injured, call 112 first. Your safety comes first.

itens.label: Free for drivers
itens.desc: Requesting and comparing quotes costs nothing, and BipFix adds nothing to the quoted price. You only pay for the service, directly to the shop.

itens.label: Your data
itens.desc: Your contact details are only visible to the shops involved in your requests, never to the public. See the details in the Privacy Policy.

itens.label: Delete the account
itens.desc: Under Profile (or on the "Delete account" page). With no completed services, everything is erased. With services, your personal data is anonymised and only the service record remains, without your name.

docsOficina.pageSubtitle: How to receive requests from customers near you, send quotes, organise your schedule and team and keep the customer informed from check-in to delivery.

secoes.intro: Registration takes a few minutes. After that, the BipFix team checks the details and approves the shop; only approved shops receive requests.

passos.title: Create the account
passos.desc: Tap "Sign up" and choose the repair shop account. Enter the name, e-mail and password of the person in charge.

passos.title: Shop details
passos.desc: Company registration number, trading name, phone number and address in separate fields (street, number, postal code, city). The address is checked on the map so that nearby customers can find you.

passos.title: Specialities
passos.desc: Tick what your workshop does: mechanics, bodywork, paint, electrics, servicing, tyres, etc. You only receive requests for these specialties.

passos.title: Service radius
passos.desc: The maximum distance (in km) of the requests you want to receive. You can change it whenever you like.

passos.title: Complete profile
passos.desc: Photos, description, opening hours and partner insurers. A customer with one of those insurers sees the badge on your quote.

secoes.intro: Each request reaches you when it meets three conditions:

itens.label: Proximity
itens.desc: The car is within your service radius.

itens.label: Speciality
itens.desc: The type of service requested is among your specialities.

itens.label: Active shop
itens.desc: The shop has been approved and is active.

secoes.texto: The alert shows up on the dashboard bell and in Requests. Each request includes photos, description, car and approximate location. Accidents reported with the "I just crashed" button arrive with priority, only to bodywork shops (collision, bodywork or paint). If you set a car limit in your Profile and the workshop is full, urgent requests go to other workshops first.
secoes.nota: Keep your specialities and radius accurate so you only receive requests that make sense for you.

passos.title: Understand the request
passos.desc: Look at the photos and description. If needed, talk to the customer first: each shop has its own conversation, which the others cannot see.

passos.title: Items
passos.desc: List parts and labour with quantity and price. If the quote is already done in another system, send a photo or the PDF: the AI fills in the items and you check them.

passos.title: Lead time and warranty
passos.desc: State the lead time in days and the warranty. The warranty counts from delivery and, until it ends, the customer keeps talking to you.

passos.title: Drop-off slots
passos.desc: Offer time slots for the customer to bring the car: today (only the periods that have not ended yet) or in the next few days. The customer picks one when accepting.

passos.title: Send
passos.desc: The customer is notified and compares it with the other quotes.

secoes.nota: Separate items (parts and labour), a clear warranty and available slots help the customer decide.

secoes.intro: If, once the car is opened up, you find something that changes the price or the lead time, use "Propose a revision" on the request page. The accepted price only changes with the customer's approval.

itens.label: What to send
itens.desc: Reason (required), the new items and the new price. One pending revision at a time.

itens.label: Customer approves
itens.desc: The new price applies. The original price stays on record and the customer sees the difference as a percentage.

itens.label: Customer declines
itens.desc: The service is closed and the customer collects the car. Agree in the conversation on what has already been done.

secoes.nota: Frequent revisions or large increases are monitored by the BipFix team. A quote done well from the start avoids revisions.

secoes.intro: The Schedule brings together booked cars, cars in service and completed ones:

itens.label: Check-in
itens.desc: Record the car's arrival. If it arrives before the booked day, the site asks you to confirm and the entry becomes today. If your workshop has bays, choose the lift or bay in "Put on". The customer is notified.

itens.label: No-show
itens.desc: If the customer does not turn up, record the no-show: the slot is released and the request goes back to the customer.

itens.label: Internal jobs
itens.desc: Create events for jobs that didn't come through BipFix and keep everything in one schedule. In Manual check-in, "The car is already here" checks it in right away.

itens.label: Board
itens.desc: Shows each mechanic or each bay on a row and cars as bars across the days, drawn over the time they actually spent in the workshop (check-in to delivery). The plan appears dashed when it differs, and the part after the promised delivery turns red. Drag a car, or tap it, to change the mechanic or the bay.

itens.label: Bays and the Hour view
itens.desc: Add your workshop bays: lift (raises the car, one at a time), floor bay (work without a lift, one at a time) and waiting space (cars parked waiting for parts, the customer or pick-up; holds several). The Hour view shows the day hour by hour: who is on each bay, when it becomes free and the bookings. Book a time by tapping the free space; the site refuses two cars on the same lift at the same time.

itens.label: Monitoring (optional)
itens.desc: Turn it on in your Profile to see, for each car, the time in the workshop, on a lift, waiting for parts or for the customer, and get alerts for a car sitting idle with no reason or a lift taken by a car that is waiting. It uses the clicks you already make; nothing extra to fill in.

itens.label: Capacity
itens.desc: In your Profile, enter how many cars fit in the workshop at the same time and, if you like, per type of service. The Board warns you when the workshop goes over the limit.

passos.title: Register
passos.desc: Register mechanics with just a name, or give access (e-mail and temporary password) to those who will log the steps from their phone. Access can be given later.

passos.title: First login
passos.desc: Whoever gets access logs in with the temporary password and creates a new one.

passos.title: Who sees what
passos.desc: A mechanic with access only sees their own cars. The person in charge sees everything and can log steps on behalf of any mechanic.

passos.title: History preserved
passos.desc: Anyone who has already worked on jobs is not deleted, only deactivated.

secoes.texto: Under Learn there are step-by-step tutorials (guided or self-paced mode), and mechanics have their own training.

secoes.intro: Under Workshop, log each step. The customer is notified at every change:

itens.label: Received and diagnosis
itens.desc: Start of the job.

itens.label: Awaiting parts / In progress
itens.desc: Shows the customer whether the car is on hold waiting for parts or being repaired. There are also pauses (customer, parts, general).

itens.label: Final testing
itens.desc: Check before release.

itens.label: Completed
itens.desc: With double confirmation. The customer is notified to come and collect the car.

itens.label: Delivered
itens.desc: Mark it when the customer collects the car: the warranty starts and the customer is invited to leave a review. If you do not mark it, the car counts as delivered after 5 days.

secoes.texto: Steps repeated within a few minutes are ignored, so the customer does not get duplicate notifications.

secoes.intro: Under Parts, request quotes from partner parts shops and neighbouring repair shops, compare and confirm the order.
secoes.texto: Payment and delivery of the parts are arranged directly with the seller.

itens.label: Rating from 1 to 5
itens.desc: Each customer leaves a review after delivery. The average is calculated automatically and appears on your public profile and on your quotes.

itens.label: Quality badge
itens.desc: Shops with an average of 4 stars or more show the badge on their quotes.

itens.label: Comments
itens.desc: See them all under Reviews.

secoes.texto: Keeping the steps up to date, meeting deadlines and avoiding price revisions are what weigh most in the reviews.

secoes.intro: Today BipFix is free for repair shops and drivers:

itens.label: No commission
itens.desc: No commission on jobs closed through the platform: the quoted price is what the customer pays, directly to you.

itens.label: No monthly fee
itens.desc: Registration, schedule, quotes, team and reviews have no monthly fee.

itens.label: Advance notice
itens.desc: If we change the way the platform charges drivers or repair shops, we will give at least 30 calendar days' notice, by e-mail and inside the platform.

secoes.texto: Under Commission, in the menu, you see the terms that currently apply to your shop.

seguroReparo.titulo: Who will pay for the repair?
seguroReparo.subtitulo: This helps the shop prepare the right quote. You can change it later.
seguroReparo.ajudaSinistro: If you don't have it yet, you can add it later.
seguroReparo.ajudaFranquia: The amount you pay under your policy (optional).
seguroReparo.dica_proprio: You pay the shop directly. Compare the quotes before choosing.
seguroReparo.dica_nao_sei: No problem: you can add this later on the accident page.
seguroReparo.dica_seguro_terceiro_br: The other driver's insurance pays. In that case you pay no deductible and you can choose the shop.
seguroReparo.dica_seguro_terceiro_ee: The other driver's compulsory motor insurance (liikluskindlustus) pays. You can also open the claim with your own insurer, which handles the rest. Usually you pay nothing.
seguroReparo.dica_seguro_proprio_br: Usually you only pay the deductible set in your policy. Check that your insurer accepts the shop you choose.
seguroReparo.dica_seguro_proprio_ee: Casco covers your own car even when the accident was your fault. Usually you only pay the deductible (omavastutus) set in your policy.
seguroReparo.passo_emergencia_br: If anyone is injured, call 192 (SAMU) or 193 (fire brigade). If you cannot agree or the other driver left, call 190.
seguroReparo.passo_emergencia_ee: If anyone is injured, if you cannot agree on who was at fault, or if the other driver left, call 112.
seguroReparo.passo_registro_br: Write down the other driver's plate, name, phone and insurer. If needed, file a police report (in many states online).
seguroReparo.passo_registro_ee: Together with the other driver, report the accident on the digital form at avarii.lkk.ee (or on the paper form), stating who was at fault.
seguroReparo.passo_seguro: Tell your insurer as soon as possible and note the claim number. Then add it on the accident page so the shop can see it.
seguroReparo.passo_oficina_seguro: The shop sends the quote to the insurer, which approves it before the repair starts.
seguroReparo.passo_proprio: Compare the quotes that come in and choose the shop.
seguroReparo.passo_nao_sei: If you have insurance, check your policy for what is covered and the deductible. You can add this later on the accident page.
seguroReparo.lembreteSinistro: The claim number is missing: when your insurer sends it, add it here so the shop can see it.
seguroReparo.oficinaDica_seguro: Send this quote to the insurer as well and wait for approval before starting. Photograph the car before and during disassembly: hidden damage becomes a supplementary quote.
seguroReparo.oficinaDica_proprio: The customer pays the shop directly.
seguroReparo.oficinaDica_nao_sei: The customer doesn't know yet whether they will use insurance. Worth asking before finalising the quote.
seguroReparo.passo_emergencia_it: If anyone is hurt, call 112. If you cannot agree or the other driver has left, call the police on 112.
seguroReparo.passo_registro_it: Fill in the CAI form (Constatazione Amichevole di Incidente) with the other driver, on paper or digitally, and both sign it. Send it to your insurer within 3 days.
seguroReparo.dica_seguro_terceiro_it: The other driver's compulsory insurance (RC Auto) pays. With direct compensation (CARD) you open the claim with your own insurer, which settles with theirs.
seguroReparo.dica_seguro_proprio_it: Comprehensive cover (kasko) pays for your car even if you were at fault. You usually pay only the excess set in your policy.
seguroReparo.passo_emergencia_pt: If anyone is hurt, call 112. If you cannot agree or the other driver has left, call the police on 112.
seguroReparo.passo_registro_pt: Fill in the Declaração Amigável (friendly accident report) with the other driver and both sign it. Each driver sends their copy to their insurer within 8 days.
seguroReparo.dica_seguro_terceiro_pt: The other driver's compulsory insurance pays. If both cars are insured in Portugal, your own insurer can handle the claim (IDS system).
seguroReparo.dica_seguro_proprio_pt: Own-damage cover pays for your car even if you were at fault. You usually pay only the excess set in your policy.
seguroReparo.passo_emergencia_geral: If anyone is hurt, call the local emergency number (112 in Europe).
seguroReparo.passo_registro_geral: Write down the other driver's plate, name, phone and insurer, and take photos. In Europe you can fill in the European Accident Statement, signed by both drivers, and send it to your insurer as soon as possible.
seguroReparo.dica_seguro_terceiro_geral: The other driver's liability insurance pays for your repair. Tell your own insurer too: they can help with the claim.
seguroReparo.dica_seguro_proprio_geral: If your policy covers damage to your own car, it pays for the repair; you usually pay the excess set in the policy.
seguroReparo.seguroOutroPais: Is your insurance from another country?
seguroReparo.cartaVerde: Foreign insurance (Green Card): your insurer handles the claim through its representative in {pais}. Ask your insurer or see the national bureau list:

chatCotacaoPeca.dica: Ask about the part or delivery time, or send a photo.
